answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the grove check immediately, the knoll audit keeps the resolved set and the fable replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 282 aliases hence pays the reading cost 282 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
